authorised_by: HARMFUL_FILL_HAZARD_TOXICITY_PLAN_V2 step 1 -- 'bind the duplicated rule-6 floor to one authority' (09ced57)
what_it_is: the MINIMUM number of permutations / draws any null in this programme may report on. It is a FAIL-CLOSED FLOOR, never a draw count.
source_of_the_rule: CLAUDE.md reliability rule 6 -- 'Declare the null before the result: design AND minimum sample (>=200 permutations / draws). A null max is an extreme-order statistic -- an under-sampled correct null flatters as much as a wrong one.'
every_other_copy_DERIVES: a module or declaration may carry the value for readability, but it must be RECONCILED against this file. p003_rule6_floor.reconcile() refuses on divergence.
why_one_authority: the floor was found in THIRTEEN places under FOUR spellings (MIN_DRAWS, RULE_6_FLOOR, MIN_PERMUTATIONS, MIN_DRAWS_011). They agree today. The failure mode is SILENT: the day two disagree, whichever the code happens to read wins and nothing says so.
it_is_a_FLOOR_not_a_TARGET: a run's draw count is declared per run (e.g. de_multiday_gate1_params_v29.min_draws_per_arm_day = 500). The floor never selects a draw count and a draw count never lowers the floor.
raising_it: a floor may be RAISED by a declared amendment. It may never be lowered, and never to fit a maintenance window (plan v2 step 2).

carriers.why_enumerated_here: so a NEW carrier is a deliberate addition to this list rather than a silent fourteenth copy. SEAT_PROTOCOL rule 32: the set is built by the OPERATION -- 'carries or enforces the minimum-draw floor' -- not by one spelling.
carriers.field_paths_are_DOTTED: four of the six live NESTED. The first reconcile() run reported them CARRIER_UNREADABLE rather than agreeing -- which is the instrument doing its job on its own carrier list.

binding_kinds.DERIVED: the name is IMPORTED from p003_rule6_floor. It cannot drift, because there is nothing to drift. Verified by AST: the assignment must NOT be a literal and must name the authority module.
binding_kinds.LITERAL: the value is typed and RECONCILED against the authority. It CAN drift, and reconcile() makes that LOUD instead of silent.
binding_kinds.why_both_exist: DA converted the four carriers it owns to DERIVED. BE's three code carriers and the six declaration carriers are RECONCILED, not edited -- converting them is their owners' act (rule 13, seat ownership). A declaration field is a RECORD and is expected to stay literal; a code constant is not.
binding_kinds.owed: BE's be_cancel_axis_null.MIN_DRAWS, be_ceiling_null.MIN_DRAWS and phase2_iter011.MIN_DRAWS_011 remain LITERAL. They are reconciled every run; converting them to DERIVED removes the last three code copies.

collisions.name: MIN_DRAWS
collisions.what_it_actually_is: the DRAW COUNT (500), not the rule-6 FLOOR (200)
collisions.why_it_is_a_hazard_anyway: at :845 it refuses `k < MIN_DRAWS` with the message 'below the declared minimum ... (rule 6)'. EIGHT other modules use the identical identifier MIN_DRAWS, cite the SAME rule, and enforce 200. Nothing on either side says which quantity it holds.
collisions.the_asymmetric_danger: harmonising DOWN to 200 silently weakens this module's guard; harmonising UP to 500 breaks the floor semantics in eight others. A future 'let us make these agree' is a coin flip with a wrong side.
collisions.routed_to: DE -- rename, not revalue. DA does not edit DE's modules.

cross_seat_note: DA owns four code carriers and two declaration carriers. The BE ones are NOT edited by this act (rule 13 and seat ownership); they are RECONCILED, so a BE copy that drifts becomes LOUD instead of silent. Converting them to derive is BE's to do.

on_divergence.behaviour: reconcile() RAISES and names every carrier that disagrees, with its value and its path
on_divergence.why_refuse_rather_than_report: a report beside a number is what let thirteen copies accumulate. The check must stop the run.

falsifier.positive_control: reconcile() over the real tree returns AGREED with n_carriers == 13
falsifier.known_bad: a fixture copy of a carrier whose value is 199 (or 201) must make reconcile() RAISE RULE6_FLOOR_DIVERGED and NAME that carrier
falsifier.partial_input: a carrier path that does not exist, or whose constant is absent, is CARRIER_UNREADABLE -- a named status, never treated as agreement

MY_FIRST_ENUMERATION_WAS_INCOMPLETE_AND_.the_mechanism_was_NOT_a_spelling_failure: the grep pattern was right and found them all. I piped it through `head -20`, the output stopped mid-list, AND I READ THE CAP AS THE SET.
MY_FIRST_ENUMERATION_WAS_INCOMPLETE_AND_.why_that_is_worth_recording: the previous three instances of this class were SPELLING failures -- one search term for a set with several. This one is a DISPLAY TRUNCATION, and it is more insidious because the instrument was correct and gave no sign of being cut off.
MY_FIRST_ENUMERATION_WAS_INCOMPLETE_AND_.the_remedy: an enumeration that feeds a declared set is counted with `wc -l`, never read off a `head`.
MY_FIRST_ENUMERATION_WAS_INCOMPLETE_AND_.found_by: DA 196's carrier census, which swept by AST over all 281 modules instead of by grep
